description: This file defines the SettingsFragment class, which manages the app's settings screen, providing UI for permission statuses and navigation to other parts of the app such as the Permissions Center and Help screens. It interacts with PermissionsManager to display current permission statuses and handle navigation.

classes.name: SettingsFragment
classes.description: Fragment responsible for displaying app settings and permission statuses, with navigation to Permissions Center and Help, and managing permission status display updates.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment's layout from XML.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes permission management, sets up button click listeners for navigation and system settings, and binds initial permission statuses.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Sets the activity title and refreshes permission status displays when returning to the fragment.

methods.name: bindPermissionStatuses
methods.description: Retrieves and displays the current permission statuses for location, media, and SMS groups.

methods.name: statusText
methods.description: Converts permission status object to a user-readable string.
